name: Settai Bihin ~Kyonyuu OL-tachi no Midara na Gogo~
original_name: 接待媚品～巨乳OL達の淫らな午後～
source:
A powerful corporation has a shadow business of training and selling meat slaves on the black market. Main character is the eldest son of the corporation owner and also a vice-president. He develops a new plan of training sex slaves and puts it into action.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
